biography.plain_text: Ali Esat Kutmangil is a Turkish industrialist and chief executive of Kutes, an iron foundry business headquartered in Istanbul. A family shareholder, he inherited interests built by his father, Mehmet Bekir, whose enterprises began in coal mining. He joined Kutes in business development and sales before taking executive charge in 2016.

long_biography.plain_text:
Adding a machining factory changed what Kutes could deliver under Ali Esat Kutmangil’s leadership. The iron-casting business began supplying finished parts directly to customers’ assembly lines. An additional moulding line also allowed one line to cover the other, improving continuity of production.

Kutmangil has also participated in a partnership between Kutes and Ahi Evran vocational school in Çorlu. He attended the agreement’s signing and visited the school with education officials. The programme was designed to give students practical machining experience alongside factory visits, while providing teachers with professional training. Its plans also included scholarships and internships.
